decisions.quote: Werner found that investors reacted positively to the accidental disclosure of covert ties to the Republican Governors Association. In contrast, when we apply the same research design to the ALEC leak, we find that, on average, firms tied to ALEC experienced negative abnormal returns.
decisions.reason: The abstract explicitly contrasts the replication's negative abnormal returns with Werner's (2017) positive investor reaction on the central finding, without stating any replicated effect that would support a mixed verdict.
